research_question: After removing generic candidate-fit suppression, does bounded recall plus all-candidate pairwise reranking expose enough raw ranking headroom for a safe winner-gated composite candidate?

frozen_architecture.authority: registered and currently authorized recalled candidates only

required_analysis: supported exact raw-top route accuracy over all supported cases
near-domain and OOD zero-threshold false-route behavior
top-score and top-margin distributions by supported-correct, supported-wrong, near-domain unsupported, and OOD groups
winner-only route-local threshold Pareto frontier under canonical no-route false budgets
development-only maximum supported exact-route accuracy under canonical false-route <=2%

threshold_derivation_policy.purpose: diagnostic only; do not freeze or implement thresholds in this experiment
threshold_derivation_policy.semantics: raw winner is fixed first; its own route-local threshold may accept it or abstain. A rejected winner must never fall through to a lower-ranked route.

decision_rule: This experiment cannot promote a candidate. It only determines whether the architecture has sufficient ranking headroom and what winner-only development Pareto frontier is available. Any behavior-changing winner gate requires a new preregistered experiment.
